comment: Independent cmd.c there_cmd_menu() witness for wintty.c tty_display_nhwindow()'s !iflags.menu_overlay arm: with menu_overlay off, the NHW_MENU window that #herecmdmenu opens clears the screen and starts at column 0 instead of overlaying the map's right half. An elven Priest on the up stairs gets a menu with 'Cast a spell'; an orcish Barbarian on another seed and date gets the same menu without it. Seeds, dates, characters and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
